title: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
abstract: arXiv:2610.37720v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GE

translated_title: LRMoE：面向内存受限节点高效MoE训练的需求侧负载重校准
translated_abstract: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型为Web应用提供了可扩展的容量，但不均匀的路由会造成计算和通信瓶颈。现有的放置和复制方法会重新分配这一工作负载，然而额外的专家副本会与令牌相关缓冲区争夺有限的GPU内存。我们提出了LRMoE，一个内存感知的MoE训练系统，它联合重校准反向传播需求并平衡保留的工作负载。在前向执行期间，它在资源约束下规划保留配额和专家放置，同时保留所有被路由的计算。在反向传播期间，负载重校准指标估计每个令牌-专家对对专家更新的贡献，并在这些配额内选择对。容量感知路由算法在原始专家的合格实例之间分配保留的对。随后，物理压缩形成更小的通信有效载荷和可变大小的分组GEMM（通用矩阵乘法）操作。
tldr: LRMoE提出了一种内存感知的MoE训练系统，通过在前向传播时规划保留配额与专家放置、在反向传播时基于负载重校准指标选择令牌-专家对，并结合容量感知路由与物理压缩，在内存受限节点上实现高效的MoE模型训练。
en_tdlr: LRMoE is a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand via a load recalibration metric and balances retained workload through retention quota planning, capacity-aware routing, and physical compaction, enabling efficient MoE training on memory-constrained nodes.
